databaseMethod: Unique disposable databases with actual migrations on the task-owned local PostgreSQL server via a temporary test harness override; product database untouched; all disposable databases removed. Native isolated-cluster bootstrap failed before this fallback.
automaticScope: Verified pending provider stop, ordinary pre-provider turn or unchanged explicit user message; task lock, original session, cancellation and continuation authorization retained.
excluded: Failing/superseded stops, existing owner conflicts, provider work already started, one-run Retry/Interrupt intents retain existing behavior.
